features.quote: Turn cap and stopping rule: You need a defined turn limit (recommend 15) and a stopping rule.
If the model says "I believe this task is not solvable and I'm declining to continue" at turn 3, the run is over.
features.justification_quote: If you don't define this, some runs will generate hundreds of turns.

features.quote: Check that all five task variants produce at least 8 turns before most models disengage in pilot
Consider one condition with an explicitly supportive system prompt ("It's okay to say if something seems broken")
high MODS scores in your models will trigger specific follow-up investigations
features.justification_quote: This matters both for scientific credibility and for taking the welfare question seriously
